name: Arugal
summary: In Shadowfang Keep, Arugal commands the worgen he summoned against the Scourge. Madness and grief have made the former Dalaran wizard their self-proclaimed father, while his power threatens Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Desperate Summons
sections.body: Before Lordaeron fell, Arugal belonged to the Kirin Tor. Some peers, including Dalar Dawnweaver, called him a charlatan who leaned on enchanted trinkets to make up for weak spellcraft. When the Scourge swept across the north during the Third War, Arugal searched for a weapon that could halt the undead. He used research by the late Dalaran mage Ur to pierce the veil between realms and summon the worgen. The ravenous beasts tore through the Scourge, but no one could contain their ferocity. Soon their hunger turned against innocent mortals.

sections.title: Fall into Madness
sections.body: The worgen slaughtered the Scourge, then turned on the wizards who summoned them. They besieged the ancestral seat of Baron Silverlaine, whose keep fell to their claws and fangs. Silverlaine and his retainers died in the massacre. Guilt shattered Arugal's mind, but he did not flee his creation. He adopted the beasts as his own offspring and renamed the fortress Shadowfang Keep. There he holds the ramparts, surrounded by ghostly victims and loyal hound-packs.

sections.title: The Scourge of Silverpine
sections.body: From Shadowfang Keep, Arugal's power reaches across the surrounding countryside. His dark sorcery blankets Pyrewood Village, where townsfolk live under a nocturnal curse, and fills the Deep Elem Mine with ravenous Moonrage beasts. The Forsaken see him as a threat they cannot tolerate. Sylvanas Windrunner's Deathstalkers and apothecaries plot the mad archmage's execution to secure the borders of their fledgling kingdom.

faq.answer: Arugal is a former human archmage of the Kirin Tor. During the Third War, he summoned the worgen to fight the Scourge. Overcome by what he had done, he withdrew to Shadowfang Keep and now leads packs of worgen as their self-proclaimed father.

faq.q: Why did Arugal summon the worgen?
faq.answer: During the Third War, the Scourge threatened to overrun northern Lordaeron. Arugal sought a weapon to stop the undead and drew on the extraplanar research of the Dalaran mage Ur. He believed the savage beasts could destroy the Scourge, but lost control of them after summoning them.

faq.q: Where does Arugal reside right now?
faq.answer: Arugal makes his lair at the pinnacle of Shadowfang Keep, an ancient fortress overlooking Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest. Fenrus, his monstrous wolf pet, guards him alongside loyal worgen and restless spirits.

Baron Silverlaine was the noble lord who ruled the fortress and the village of Pyrewood. When Arugal's worgen besieged the castle, Silverlaine and his court were slaughtered. Their tortured ghosts haunt the keep's halls.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Arugal dead?
faq.answer: Arugal's packs terrorize Silverpine Forest, attacking Forsaken scouts, ambushing patrols, and infecting servants of the Royal Apothecary Society. Sylvanas Windrunner sees the mad archmage as a direct threat to the security and expansion of the Undercity's borders.

faq.q: What is the curse on Pyrewood Village?
faq.answer: Arugal's enchantments subjected Pyrewood Village's human inhabitants to the worgen curse. By daylight, the villagers appear human, but at nightfall they transform into vicious beasts bound to defend Arugal's territory.

angles.text: Arugal's worgen infest the road south of the Sepulcher, and Lady Sylvanas has ordered his execution to secure Silverpine Forest for the Forsaken.
Arugal's beasts have killed several Deathstalkers and apothecaries. The Royal Apothecary Society needs his madness ended.
Arugal shows the danger of reckless conjuration: Kirin Tor research became an uncontrollable nightmare.
